title: Money
description: A monetary amount bound to a currency. Never a bare number. No IEEE-754 floating point may cross a financial contract (docs/03).

currency.description: ISO 4217 alphabetic code for fiat, or an explicitly configured asset code for digital assets.

amount.description: Base-10 decimal string. Sign is explicit; there is no implicit or defaulted sign.

scale.description: Optional explicit minor-unit scale when the venue or asset requires it. Absent means the amount's own digit count is authoritative.

x-invariants: Amount precision must be validated against the currency's configured scale before it reaches a venue.
A currency mismatch between an amount and a venue or account is a hard rejection, not a conversion.
Zero must be written with an explicit sign convention and currency; it is not a null substitute.
